The ritual

From bean to table

  1. 01

    Bean

    Argentine coffee, ground fresh every morning. The first cup is the reason Brickell regulars plan their route past our door.

  2. 02

    Brew

    Pulled slow and served hot — espresso, cortadito, café con leche. No rush, no shortcuts, just coffee made the way it should be.

  3. 03

    Pour

    Empanadas warm from the oven, flan and chocotorta to finish. The case changes through the day — ask what came out most recently.

  4. 04

    Table

    A table in Brickell, in the middle of the working day. Walk in hungry, walk out already planning your next visit.

    Our Story

    Golden Cafe cooks like
    somebody's watching.

    Every morning at Golden Cafe, the kitchen fires up before the sun does. Recipes are honed, not hacked together — the kind of cafe Miami keeps coming back for because it tastes like somebody cared.

    Walk in hungry. Walk out already planning your next visit.

    Our standard is simple: cafe made fresh, served the way we'd want it ourselves. If something isn't right, tell us and we'll make it right.

    Good to know

    Before you come.

    What to expect

    Your table is waiting if you booked; walk-ins take the next free one. Order at the table, food comes out when it's ready, and the bill comes when you ask for it.

    Duration

    Most tables are in and out in about an hour; a slow dinner with friends, two. Tell us if you're in a rush and we'll pace it to your evening.

    Our guarantee

    Tell your server and we'll make it again or take it off the bill — no argument, no awkwardness.
